_comment: Ordered list of the visuals the site publishes. Each id is a folder under site/visuals/ holding visual.json (title, blurb, filters) and build.py (def build(ctx)). The homepage index, the nav and the CI matrix are all generated from this list: adding a visual is adding a folder and a line here. `default_study` is the study (studies/<id>.json) every page opens in when the address names none; `all` or a missing key opens on every run. A maintainer's choice, kept here so a study pull request cannot change it.
